slides.headline: STOP
slides.body: Stop rereading your notes like a comfort show.

slides.headline: Why it fails
slides.body: Highlighting everything feels productive. Your brain never has to retrieve — so quiz day hits blank.

slides.headline: 1 · Timer: 8 min
slides.body: Close the book. Write everything you remember about tomorrow's topic.

slides.headline: 2 · Open & check
slides.body: Compare to notes. Mark only the gaps — that's your real study list.

slides.headline: 3 · Study the blanks
slides.body: Only then open notes / video — aimed at holes, not the whole chapter.

slides.headline: Try tonight · 1 chapter
slides.body: Comment cooked / not cooked after one dump.
